verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਜ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਮਾਥੈ ਲਾਗੀ ਬਾਛਤ ਸਕਲ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪਗ ਰੇਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: charan kamal raj gur sikh maathai laagee baachhat sakal gursikh pag ren hai ||

en.bdb: A Sikh of the Guru who is blessed by the holy dust of the feet of the True Guru (who receives the boon of Naam Simran from the True Guru), the entire Universe crave for the dust of his feet.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਨਿ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਕਮਲਾ ਕਲਪਤਰੁ ਪਾਰਸ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਨਿ ਕਾਮਧੇਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: koTan koTaan koT kamalaa kalapatar paaras a(n)mirat chi(n)taaman kaamadhen hai ||

en.bdb: Millions of goddesses of wealth, tree of Indra's heavenly garden (Kalap- Variksh), philosopher stones, elixirs, distress removing forces and heavenly cows (Kamdhenu) desire the touch of such a Sikh of the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਨਾਥ ਮੁਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਨ ਅਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਕਾਲ ਲੋਗ ਬੇਦ ਗਿਆਨ ਉਨਮਾਨ ਜੇਨ ਕੇਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sur nar naath mun tirabhavan aau tirakaal log bedh giaan unamaan jen ken hai ||

en.bdb: Millions of gods, humans, sages, master yogis, all the three worlds, the three times, wondrous knowledge of Vedas and many such estimates beg for the holy dust of the feet of such a disciple of the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਨਿ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਅਸੰਖ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਨਮੋ ਨਮੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਦੇਨ ਹੈ ॥੧੯੩॥
verses.translit_en: koTan koTaan sikh sa(n)gat asa(n)kh jaa kai namo namo gurmukh sukh fal dhen hai ||193||

en.bdb: There are numerous congregations of such Sikhs of the True Guru. I bow again and again before such True Guru who is the blesser of such elixir-like Naam that provides comfort and peace. (193)
